verdict.rationale: Community evidence confirms Ollama ships ROCm containers for AMD GPUs (comm-9) and has been used with NVIDIA and Apple Silicon (comm-1, comm-3), showing multi-vendor GPU acceleration works in practice. However another report shows ROCm detection failing and falling back to CPU (comm-11), and no first-party docs in the pack explicitly document supported vendor kernels or configuration, indicating real but imperfect vendor-specific acceleration support. Missing for 10: official documentation enumerating supported GPU vendors/kernels, reliable auto-detection guarantees, and independent benchmarks confirming consistent acceleration across NVIDIA/AMD/other vendors.
